Scenario: Composer shows who you post as
Preconditions: Student signed in on SQA Team; General channel
Steps: 1. Tap Post. 2. Look under the channel name.
Expected Result: Row 'Posting as <your name>' is shown by default

Steps: 1. Tap the 'Posting as' row.
Expected Result: Sheet 'Choose who to post as' lists You, Set up your alias (or the alias), Anonymous
Notes: After an alias exists the list shows You / alias / Anonymous / Edit alias.

Steps: 1. Read the hint under the options.
Expected Result: Hint says anonymous posts are hidden from members and moderators can see who you are
Notes: Text: 'Hidden from members. Moderators can see who you are.'

Scenario: Note after choosing alias or anonymous
Steps: 1. Choose Anonymous (then alias). 2. Look at the composer.
Expected Result: A note warns that moderators can still see who posted
Notes: Text: 'Hidden from members, not from moderators. In small groups, people may still guess who posted.'

Scenario: Chooser in a channel that does not allow anonymous or alias
Preconditions: A channel with the setting off
Steps: 1. Open the composer in that channel.
Expected Result: Anonymous and alias are not offered
Notes: The Mineral channel composer has no Posting as row (no anonymous or alias offered). Nothing was posted.

Steps: 1. Tap Posting as. 2. Tap Set up your alias.
Expected Result: Form shows Alias name, character counter, 11 characters, colors, Cancel and Create alias
Notes: Counter starts at '30 characters remaining'.

Steps: 1. Leave the name empty. 2. Tap Create alias.
Expected Result: Error and no alias is created
Notes: Message: 'Use 3 to 30 characters.'

Steps: 1. Type A. 2. Tap Create alias.
Notes: Web had a bug where 2 characters were accepted; the app rejects 1 and 2 characters.

Steps: 1. Type An. 2. Tap Create alias.
Notes: Message: 'Use 3 to 30 characters.'

Steps: 1. Type 34 characters.
Notes: Field keeps 30 characters; counter shows 'No characters remaining'.

Preconditions: Another member has the alias Nightcrowler
Steps: 1. Type the same name. 2. Tap Create alias.
Notes: Message: 'That name, or one that looks like it, is already taken.'

Scenario: Special characters and HTML in the name
Steps: 1. Type Bold & 'q'. 2. Tap Create alias.
Notes: Message: 'Start with a letter or number. Then use letters, numbers, spaces and . _ ' - only.'

Steps: 1. Pick a character and color. 2. Tap Cancel.
Notes: Chooser still shows 'Set up your alias'.

Scenario: Create a valid alias with character and color
Steps: 1. Type a valid name. 2. Pick Shiba and Red. 3. Tap Create alias.
Expected Result: Alias is created and chosen for the post
Notes: Composer switches to 'Posting as <alias>'. Alias QA Fox Tester left in the community (no delete option found).

Scenario: Edit alias: name is locked after creating
Steps: 1. Chooser > Edit alias.
Expected Result: Name cannot be changed yet; the date it can be changed again is shown
Notes: Name field is read only. Text: 'You can rename your alias again on 30 Nov 2026.'

Scenario: Change the character of the alias
Steps: 1. Edit alias. 2. Pick the Fox character. 3. Tap Save.
Expected Result: New character is saved and shown in the chooser

Steps: 1. Choose the alias. 2. Type text. 3. Tap Post.
Expected Result: Post shows the alias name with an Alias badge and the character avatar; no real name

Steps: 1. Open Comment. 2. Write and send.
Expected Result: Comment is shown as Alias with the alias character

Scenario: Alias post as seen by the admin on web
Steps: 1. Admin opens the General channel on web.
Expected Result: Alias name with Alias badge; real name hidden

Scenario: Alias avatar after changing the character
Preconditions: Alias post made before the change
Steps: 1. Change the character. 2. Open the old post on the feed.
Expected Result: Old post shows the new character
Notes: Old post still showed the old character until the feed was pulled to refresh, then it updated. Minor; not reported.

Steps: 1. Open the post menu. 2. Tap Delete post. 3. Confirm.
Expected Result: Post removed after a confirm dialog
Notes: Dialog: 'Are you sure you want to delete this post? This action cannot be undone.'

Steps: 1. Reply to a comment as alias.
Notes: Reply to an alias comment shows Alias with the alias character.

Steps: 1. Edit the post and save.
Notes: After editing the post is still shown as Alias with an Edited label.

Steps: 1. Open the post as another member.
Notes: Seen on web as another member (a second web login): alias post shows QA Fox Tester with an Alias badge; real name not shown.

Steps: 1. Edit alias. 2. Change the name.
Notes: Not run: lock runs until 30 Nov 2026.

Steps: 1. Look for a delete option.
Expected Result: Alias can be removed or the limitation is clear
Notes: No delete option was found on the Edit alias sheet. Alias QA Fox Tester is still there.

Steps: 1. Check the notification text for the post owner.
Notes: Admin notifications show the alias name (QA Fox Tester posted in General / commented on your post), not the real name.

Steps: 1. Tap Post. 2. Posting as > Anonymous. 3. Type text. 4. Post.
Expected Result: Post appears in the feed as Anonymous with no name

Scenario: Anonymous post seen by the admin on web
Steps: 1. Admin opens General on web.
1. Tap the post menu.
Expected Result: Options Copy text, Save post, Pin post, Edit post, Turn off commenting, Delete post; no Reveal author
Notes: Pin and Turn off commenting show because the student role has Manage Channel (owner confirmed 2026-11-20).

Steps: 1. Menu > Edit post. 2. Change text. 3. Update.
Notes: Edit screen shows 'Posting as Anonymous'; feed shows 'Edited'.

Steps: 1. Menu > Delete post. 2. Confirm.
1. Open own profile > Posts.
Notes: Own profile lists the anonymous and alias posts and comments (this is the owner's own view).

Scenario: Anonymous comment on own anonymous post
Steps: 1. Open Comment. 2. Write and send.
Notes: Comment screen shows 'Posting as Anonymous'.

Steps: 1. Long-press the comment.
1. Long-press > Delete. 2. Confirm.
Expected Result: Comment removed after a confirm dialog

Scenario: Comment on another member's alias post
Steps: 1. Open the post. 2. Write and send.
Expected Result: Comment goes out under your real name (no chooser)
Notes: No 'comment as' chooser was seen on another member's alias post; the comment shows the real name. Earlier session (2026-11-20) had a chooser on others' anonymous posts. Confirm this is intended.

Scenario: Anonymous comment on another member's anonymous post
Steps: 1. Comment as Anonymous.
Notes: The comment chooser is the person icon left of the comment field: You / Anonymous / Edit alias. Comment shows Anonymous 1.

Steps: 1. Reply as Anonymous.
Notes: Composer shows Replying to @Anonymous, Posting as Anonymous; the reply shows Anonymous.

Steps: 1. Long-press > Edit.
Notes: Edited comment stays Anonymous.

Notes: Poll form works (question and 2 options) but after adding a poll the post text was lost and Post stayed disabled, so no poll post was made. Needs a manual look. Image and audio not tried.
